query:
-- Extrait CO2 de Gingembre - Zingibérène
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 25.0, 1, 'stable', 'Sesquiterpène caractéristique du gingembre'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-001' AND m.name LIKE '%Zingib%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Vanille - Vanilline
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 2.5, 1, 'stable', 'Molécule signature de la vanille'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-002' AND m.name LIKE '%Vanillin%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Café - Caféine (si existe)
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 1.5, 1, 'stable', 'Alcaloïde caractéristique'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-003' AND m.name LIKE '%Caféine%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Romarin - Acide rosmarinique
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 5.0, 1, 'stable', 'Composé phénolique antioxydant'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-008' AND m.name LIKE '%Rosmarin%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Poivre noir - Pipérine
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 6.0, 1, 'stable', 'Alcaloïde responsable du piquant'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-010' AND m.name LIKE '%Pipérine%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Cardamome - 1,8-Cinéole
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 35.0, 1, 'stable', 'Note fraîche eucalyptée'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-011' AND m.name LIKE '%Cinéole%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Curcuma - Curcumine
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 3.0, 1, 'stable', 'Pigment jaune caractéristique'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-012' AND m.name LIKE '%Curcum%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;

-- Extrait CO2 de Cannabis - Myrcène
INSERT INTO raw_material_molecules (raw_material_id, molecule_id, percentage, is_signature, variability, notes)
SELECT rm.id, m.id, 20.0, 1, 'variable', 'Terpène principal du cannabis'
FROM raw_materials rm, molecules m
WHERE rm.material_id = 'RM-CO2-015' AND m.name LIKE '%Myrcène%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_material_molecules rmm WHERE rmm.raw_material_id = rm.id AND rmm.molecule_id = m.id)
LIMIT 1;
